name: HugoMods
post_parameters: -c set -e; echo ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━; echo 🕹️  Hugo Website Boot; echo ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━; cd /src; if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo 📁 First boot - cloning repository; GR=`printenv GIT_REPO 2>/dev/null || true`; if [ -z $GR ]; then echo ❌ ERROR: GIT_REPO is not set; exit 1; fi; echo 🔄 Cloning: $GR; rm -rf /tmp/repo; git clone -b main $GR /tmp/repo; mv /tmp/repo/* /tmp/repo/.[!.]* /src/ 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf /tmp/repo; echo ✅ Repository cloned; elif [ -d .git ]; then echo 🔄 Updating repository; git pull || echo ⚠️  Git pull failed, continuing with existing code; else echo ✅ Source code exists (not a git repo); fi; echo 📦 Installing dependencies…; npm install; echo 🏗️  Building site…; exec npm run build
description: Build and deploy Hugo static websites on Unraid. Automatically clones your Git repository, installs dependencies, and builds your Hugo site. Perfect for generating static sites for blogs, documentation, landing pages, and more with Hugo's blazing-fast static site generation. Features persistent storage for source code and node_modules, automatic dependency management, and support for custom Hugo configurations. Simply provide your Git repository URL and the site will be built in the /src/public directory.

paths.name: Website Source Code
paths.description: Persistent Hugo source directory. Repo is cloned here on first start.

paths.name: Hugo Config Directory
paths.description: Hugo configuration directory. Create config/_default/hugo.toml to override settings. See https://gohugo.io/configuration/introduction/#configuration-directory

paths.name: node_modules Cache
paths.description: Persist node_modules to avoid reinstalling on every restart.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: Public git repository containing your Hugo website (required).

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for Hugo site (used in build). Example: / or /mysite/
